issues.legal_issue: Section 352 of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act authorizes identification of land for public purposes but does not confer a power of compulsory acquisition.
Compulsory acquisition under the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act must proceed under Section 537, with the State Government exercising its discretion upon the Municipal Commissioner’s application.
Section 363 of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act does not provide for compensation in cases of compulsory acquisition.

A valid compulsory acquisition under Article 300A requires more than acquisition authority and fair compensation; it must include procedures protecting the rights to notice, hearing, a reasoned decision, public purpose, restitution or fair compensation, an efficient and timely process, and conclusion of the proceedings.
Section 352 is not a valid authority for compulsory acquisition because it prescribes none of the procedures required by Article 300A.
